lines: Phases 1 to 5 complete. Phase 6 in progress. Three words are asked of Brandon and all three still stand. One: move on to the film and the masters, or one more round of looks first, asked in Status 236 at about 5:20 PM MT Friday. Two: take the level line's mend, yes or no, asked in Status 262. Three is wider now: take the two what-ifs that both fresh reviewers say to take, fall's lit faces going out before winter's base comes and summer's sand mound breaking up as it leaves, yes or no. The work goes on in any case and only the freeze waits.

Both fresh reviewers have answered on the what-ifs (decision 319). They are two fresh agents of two model families and neither knew how a what-if was built. All scores are theirs, read from their files, a score for the main branch first and for the what-if second. The lit faces: 5 to 8 and 8 to 9, take it from both. The mound leaving: 6 to 8 and 7 to 9, take it from both (third picture: one streaked smear on the main branch above, a soft grainy body in the what-if below; the second reviewer names a faint fringe of fine strands under its crest, seen only enlarged). The leaves at the landing: 6 to 7 and 7 to 8, and both say take it after one mend and name the same mend: a leaf in fast flight reads as a flat paper shape with a solid fill and a hard edge (second picture) and should fade at its ends and keep its own mottling. Neither could judge how any of them plays, since they had single frames.

The sand sprinkle got both answers too, at 8:30 and 8:36 AM MT. The first: 6 to 7, take it after one mend, because the last stretch before the tip is still nearly ruled and the shape is still a wedge closing to a point aimed at the base (first picture). The second: 8 to 9, take it, the edge reads as spilled sand. Both call it better than the main branch and neither names a cost.

Two reworks are ordered from the what-ifs' builder at 8:34 AM MT, as what-ifs on its branch and nothing more. First the leaves: the smear of a moving leaf fades toward both ends of its way and keeps two or three tones of its own colour, with the ribs that the first rework cured staying gone; due 9:50 AM MT with film frames 2162, 2163 and 2170 at 4K as the masters draw them. Then the sprinkle's tip: the fraying carried through to the tip and the dense head broken into loose grains; due 10:40 AM MT with film frames 2072 and 2096 at 4K. A cure for hard ended smears in the shutter itself is not ordered: it would change every moving frame of the masters for a gain the reviewers saw in stopped frames only.

A played pair is ordered so that the two what-ifs on offer can be watched and not only read: film frames 2016 to 2158 and 2740 to 2878 as a draft, the main branch above and the what-if below, due about 9:20 AM MT as Preview 10.

Both reviewers also name faults that are alike on the main branch and in the what-ifs, all in fall's and summer's storms and all seen in stopped frames: bright reflections on the base breaking into repeated dashes, a zipper of fine bars on a shiny branch, the cobweb as a flat grey sail, and flat pale green four sided pieces inside the globe in the shake out of summer (open items 289 and 291). No work is ordered on them: that is the further round the first word asks about.

Still under way and not changed since Status 271: the lost drawing's mend is with its fresh critic, due 9:15 AM MT; the sound's warm start is to be pushed by 9:40 AM MT; the render instructions' joined version is due 10:15 AM MT and its whole report 11:00 AM MT; the finder of why a hosted Mac drops the drawing reports about 10:25 AM MT.

Remaining in phase 6 and what he receives. The render instructions: one file in the repo and one line to give Claude Code, after the steps above. The what-ifs, each shown before and after at 4K with the reviewers' words. On his word the freeze: the repo goes private and the references are redrawn. Then the film steps of the build order and the full 4K 60 render on his gaming PC on his word: With Prompt and Without Prompt at 3840x2160, the Portfolio Looping Video and the Portfolio Screenshot. Last the fresh review and BUILD COMPLETE. Sound credits 7,420 of 10,000 (measured from the ledger at 8:37 AM MT, 52 calls, the last on Wednesday at 10:47 PM MT).
phase 6: 60.80 h used of its 12.00 h box
allowance (after the review): 60.80 h used of 12.00 h allowed
